# TShark 4.4 packet regressions

These PCAPs are original, synthetic radiotap/802.11 packets generated by
`build_captures.py`. They contain invented local MAC addresses and the SSID
`Trixie-Test`; no packets or code were copied from another project. Regenerate
with `python tests/fixtures/tshark_4_4/build_captures.py`.

The TSVs and ordered `fields.json` were exported through the application's
production dissector chain and preferences using the official macOS Arm64
TShark 4.4.19 (`v4.4.19-0-gbb1640e38673`) on October 12, 2026. The temporary
Wireshark disk image matched the [published SHA256](https://lists.wireshark.org/archives/wireshark-announce/202609/msg00001.html):
`bec0b702cef7cfe9c6a977361619724390d9624fd0793ffd33e0cb992dbd876a`.
No Wireshark binaries are stored in this repository.

Each capture contains nine frames: a beacon, two retries of the same data
sequence, one original unicast data frame, group data, a probe request, ACK,
Action No Ack, and retry-marked unicast authentication. Independently expected
retry counts are 3 / 4 = 75%, including both repeated transmissions.

Each beacon advertises QBSS CU 128/255, station count 12, admission capacity
42, and interval 100 TU. Radiotap RSSI is -47 dBm. Channel definitions are:

| Capture | Primary MHz | Width MHz | Center MHz | Puncturing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ht40 | 2412 | 40 | 2422 | absent |
| vht160 | 5180 | 160 | 5250 | absent |
| he80 | 5975 | 80 | 5985 | absent |
| eht320 | 5955 | 320 | 6105 | bitmap 0x4 |

TShark 4.4.19 emits `wlan.ssid` as FT_BYTES / `5472697869652d54657374`, which
confirmed the hex SSID issue. These fixtures preserve the decoder's raw output;
parser regression checks now require the readable `Trixie-Test` name.

Saved TSV regression tests always run without TShark. Packet decode tests run
when TShark is available; set `WLANPI_TEST_TSHARK` to select a specific binary.
`scripts/check_tshark.py` runs packet checks without pytest or Wi-Fi hardware.
These cases prove decoding, not live adapter/driver frame delivery, legal tune
availability, or survey-counter support.
